name: ruff-quality
description: Makes every Python file Claude edits pass Ruff. A plugin hook applies Ruff's safe fixes, formats and re-checks each .py, .pyw and .pyi file with the Ruff already installed in your project or globally, using your own Ruff configuration; asks you before Claude adds a suppression comment or changes Ruff configuration; and keeps Claude working, up to 7 attempts, until the files it touched are clean. Its skill teaches Claude to install, configure, run, integrate and diagnose Ruff from the official documentation.

enabled.title: Ruff hook
enabled.description: On: after each edit Claude makes to a .py, .pyw or .pyi file, the hook fixes, formats and checks it, and keeps Claude working until it passes. Off: the hooks do nothing; the skill stays available.
